name: Sarnafil Décor Profile PVC
paste:
SARNAFIL® DÉCOR PROFILE PVC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sarnafil_decor_profilepvc.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC is an polyvinyl chloride (PVC) extruded profile made which is welded to PVC sheet waterproofing membranes to replicate standing seam metal roofing systems.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC creates an appearance of a standing seam metal roof
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: PVC Decor Profile
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN ISO 11925-2: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
    - EN 13501-1: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Applicable for exposed roofing
    - Easily applied
    - Resistant to UV exposure.
    - Suitable for any roof slope
    - Hot air weldable
    - Available in various colours
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC), profile extruded
2.6 Appearance and colour.
    | Surface: | smooth |
    | Colour: | light grey (nearest RAL 7047) |
    | lead grey (Sika colour no. 9500) window grey (nearest RAL 7040) copper patina (Sika colour no. 6525) copper brown (nearest RAL 8004) traffic white (nearest RAL 9016) |
    | Other colours on request. Subject to minimum order quantities. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.7 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Length: 3000 mm (+10 mm / -5 mm)
    - Width: 35 mm (+/- 1,3 mm)
    - Height: 25 mm (+/- 1,3 mm)
    - Mass per area: ~285 g/m
2.8 Reaction to fire.
    | Class E | (EN ISO 11925-2, classification to EN 13501-1) |
2.9 System structure. The following products must be considered for use depending on roof design:
    - Sarnamatic® 681/661 Conversion kit Decor Profile
    - Sarnafil® G 410 EL-types
    - Sarnafil® G 410 EL Felt-types
    - Sarnafil® S 327 EL-types
2.10 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Cardboard containers of 25 pieces including connector plugs.
    - Shelf life: 5 years from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application.
    - Installation procedure
    - Ensure the Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC is tacked into position at the desired centres and hot air weld into place to the roof membrane. Join two or more Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVCs together, using the connector plugs supplied. Finish the end of the profile with a piece of hot air welded membrane if required.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations. Installation work must only be carried out by Sika® trained and approved contractors, experienced in this type of application.
    - Ensure Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC is prevented from direct contact with incompatible materials (refer to compatibility section).
    - The use of Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC membrane is limited to geographical locations with average monthly minimum temperatures of -50 °C. Permanent ambient temperature during use is limited to +50 °C.
    - The use of some ancillary products such as adhesives, cleaners and solvents is limited to temperatures above +5 °C. Observe temperature limitations in the appropriate Product Data Sheets.
    - Special measures may be compulsory for installation below +5 °C ambient temperature due to safety requirements in accordance with national regulations.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. -20 °C min. / +60 °C max.
5.3 Substrate temperature. -30 °C min. / +60 °C max.
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - The use of Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC membrane is limited to geographical locations with average monthly minimum temperatures of -50 °C. Permanent ambient temperature during use is limited to +50 °C.
    - The use of some ancillary products such as adhesives, cleaners and solvents is limited to temperatures above +5 °C. Observe temperature limitations in the appropriate Product Data Sheets.
    - Special measures may be compulsory for installation below +5 °C ambient temperature due to safety requirements in accordance with national regulations.
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sarnafil_decor_profilepvc.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Fresh air ventilation must be ensured, when working (welding) in closed rooms.
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.4 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.5 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.6 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
